payload.entry: Planning evidence at 92706cb4: no prior phase notes or implementation to resume. Source shows queued_files concatenates pending and running paths, while spool::move_job installs running before removing pending, so one job can be counted twice; this is a concrete candidate, not a reproduced historical panic. kick already redirects stdio and calls setsid. Authored and validated a medium tale requiring full-load diagnostics, controlled queue-overlap reproduction, a narrow evidence-backed fix, retained under-10-second timing guard, and just check. No implementation changes or test executions yet; target bob-cli-5o remains for the parent lander. Plan proposal handoff follows.

BASELINE: Canonical ignore source is the vault git file ~/bob/.gitignore (tracked in the vault repo). chezmoi does not manage it; bob-plugins is only the deploy source. Custom-plugin block lists block-id-prompt, bob-command-mode, bob-ledger-tools, bob-navigation-hotkeys, bob-project-tasks, bob-vim-surround, task-status-cycler and omits bob-articles. git check-ignore -v .obsidian/plugins/bob-articles/main.js is empty. git ls-files lists main.js, manifest.json, styles.css. Comment still cites ~/projects/github/bbugyi200/bob-plugins. Hosts athena, apollo, and mac are all at vault SHA 4f5ce0ac with those three files tracked and bob-articles 0.2.1 synced/enabled. bob-vault-sync.service is active on athena and apollo. Mac LaunchAgent com.bbugyi.bob-vault-sync is loaded with StartInterval 15s (idle between runs). Live-vault repair will go through a Bryan-approved sase gate so untrack is not done on one host alone. Target task bob-cli-cd stays open for the lander.

Planning investigation on clean base 92706cb4: src/native/dataview.rs::run_native unconditionally builds NativeVault/DataviewIndex before dispatching Tasks or TasksNote; both then build TaskIndex and never consume the Dataview index. QueryContext reads origin frontmatter independently. This explains duplicate whole-vault reads; PageDraft/list_object also allocate unused page/list metadata. No runtime measurements or implementation changes yet. Authored a medium tale for narrow dispatch separation, lightweight explicit-origin compatibility, a capped-memory CLI regression, comparable before/after wall-time/RSS/read-count evidence, and just check. Validation passed with zero warnings. No epic-symbol entries found. Submitting through sase plan propose; phase and target bob-cli-6k remain open for implementation and parent landing respectively.
PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Make bob plugins sync maintain the vault custom-plugin gitignore block from the plugin roster — a newly added plugin can be tracked again if only ~/bob/.gitignore is hand-edited.
